articles.summary: A 24-year-old woman escaped a hotel in Meerut where her ex-boyfriend confined and assaulted her. She reported that he chased her after she fled the hotel room on Tuesday.

articles.title: Shooting outside Pune court: Man’s hand chopped off in sickle assault
articles.summary: On Wednesday afternoon, a violent attack occurred outside the Shivajinagar District Court in Pune. Armed men opened fire and injured two individuals, one critically.

articles.title: Pak astronaut Ali reaches China's space station
articles.summary: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani astronaut, has reached the Tiangong space station in China. He launched aboard the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft alongside two Chinese astronauts, Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi.

articles.title: BSF Tradesman admit card 2026 out at rectt.bsf.gov.in: Download hall ticket PDF, check exam date and shift timings
articles.summary: The Border Security Force (BSF) has released the Constable Tradesman Admit Card 2026 on November 17. Candidates shortlisted for the written examination can download their hall tickets from rectt.bsf.gov.in using their login credentials.

articles.title: CDAC C-CAT 2027 registration begins at cdac.in: Check eligibility, exam dates and direct link to apply
articles.summary: C-DAC has started the registration for the Common Admission Test 2027, with applications open until December 29, 2026. Candidates can download their admit cards between January 5 and January 9, 2027.

articles.title: Rajasthan CET 12th Level admit card 2026 to be released on November 26: Check complete details here
articles.summary: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) will release the Rajasthan CET 12th Level Admit Card 2026 on November 26. Candidates appearing for the December 1, 2 and 3 examinations can download their hall tickets through the Rajasthan Recruitment Portal or SSO ID.

articles.title: New York beats California as top US state for foreign students; Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan record all-time highs amid shifting enrolment trends
articles.summary: New York has overtaken California as the leading US destination for international students, hosting 133,715 students in 2025/26, according to IIE's Open Doors 2026 report. Overall, international student numbers in the US declined 2.7% to 1.14 million, marking the first annual fall since 2020/21.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' Day 20: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film earns Rs 17.50 cr
articles.summary: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend achieved notable box office success on November 24 with significant earnings increase. The film collected Rs 17.50 cr in India, marking a 37.8% rise from the previous day.

articles.title: 'O.M' BO Day 6 [Live]: Dhanush, Sai Pallavi's film sees further drop
articles.summary: Dhanush's film 'O.M: Operation Mole' was released on November 20 and initially performed well at the box office. The film collected Rs 18.10 crore on its opening day, followed by similar successes on subsequent days.

articles.title: Salim Khan Birthday: Iulia Vantur shares tribute
articles.summary: Salim Khan, the veteran screenwriter and Khan family patriarch, turned 91 on November 24. Salman Khan's close friend Iulia Vantur wished him on Instagram with a photo of the two, calling him her "heart's place." Fans and celebrities showered love on the post.

articles.title: Grammy nominated Aakash Ravikrishnan on working with Chris Brown’s Appreciate It: ‘Feels huge’
articles.summary: Aakash Ravikrishnan, a talented Indian music producer, has made waves in the industry with his Grammy nomination for his contributions to Chris Brown's latest album. Over his impressive 20-year career, Aakash has collaborated with numerous renowned artists.
